from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyCapitalReserve(BaseModel):
    """Capital reserve (资本公积) value reported by a single company in their financial report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the company whose financial report this is")
    capital_reserve: float | None = Field(description="The capital reserve (资本公积) amount reported")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="Currency of the reported amount")
    report_period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period for this financial data")
    document_source: str | None = Field(description="Identifier or source name of this document")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_capital_reserves: list[CompanyCapitalReserve]
